payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: sase agent list defaults to index_freshness=cached, which can omit a just-spawned ace-run after the first agent has already populated the index; the tutorial harness now falls back to on-disk agent_meta.json. A CLI/TUI revalidate-after-launch (or fail-closed empty-index) would make the second sase run visible without that fallback.

Root cause: wait_for_launch polled sase agent list -j for status==RUNNING only. first-change is the second sase run in the same HOME; fakey can leave STARTING and reach DONE before the first RUNNING poll, and the default list omits completed agents. Fix is harness-only: snapshot names, poll list -a -j for any new name (STARTING/DONE included), fall back to agent_meta.json on disk when the listing index is stale, then sase agent wait. Timeout now includes sase run exit/stdout/stderr, list -a output, and HOME artifact state. Unit tests cover STARTING, already-DONE, disk fallback, and diagnostic payload. test_start_tutorials_pass_on_fakey passed 6 consecutive local runs (19-32s).
